correctness.rationale: Line–edge intersection for the actual square and rhombus reduces Φ² on all 16 edge-pair charts to five affine cases, each preserving L=m+n+ε. The depth state cycles with least length 2L+1; exactly one antipodal edge transition and a central affine reflection force a second cycle for first return of Φ², while Φ alternates orientations. Thus primitive Φ period is 8L+4 on regular open cells, not merely a divisor. The Jacobian determinant density |det(E_i,D_j)| is invariant, with weights 16 for even parity and8 for odd, so ε has probabilities 2/3,1/3 and inward dyadic depths are independent Geometric(1/2). Convolution yields P(P=8k+4)=(2k+1)/(3·2^(k+1)), mean 68/3, and exponential threshold log2/8. Independent rational geometric intersection verified 144 primitive periods across all edge pairs and depth pairs 0..2; cannot certify all real cells by sampling.
